reviewed_by: Almuthanna Shihab with Claude Code; requires supervisor approval before the first acquisition
policy: Exactly these URLs, over HTTPS, without redirects; nothing is crawled or discovered.
Every file is size-checked and SHA-256-verified before it is kept; archives are opened in memory and only the listed members are accepted.
Password-protected archives, unexpected member names, unsafe paths and oversized content are rejected.
Acquisition runs on an online host that is NOT the scanning VM; only verified files are transferred into the offline VM.
No downloaded file is opened by a document reader. Didier Stevens' scripts run only as the fixed commands in evaluation/prepare_samples.py and evaluation/benchmark.py.
